notes:
Re-points impl/bm25-ranking/field-bm25-idf-coverage at positional-index after inverted-index was
deprecated: the contract's statement never changed, only the name of the reader interface it scores
over, so the scoring code and its gate are byte-identical. Read that submission's notes for the
formula, the tuning and the coverage dead end — they still stand.

Positions cost relevance nothing, and that is measured, not assumed: mean P@10 0.2560 and mean
recall@10 0.8533 over bench/queries.json, the same four decimals as before the format change.
rank() never looks at a posting's positions; it reads body/title, which the reader now derives from
them. A phrase query reaches rank() as an ordinary term query over the full corpus, and the phrase
filter is applied to the ranked ids afterwards — which is why phrase results keep global idf and the
ordinary ranking's order instead of being re-scored inside a tiny candidate set.
